evals.name: explicit-submission
evals.prompt: Di repo acme/web, halaman billing crash kalau invoice punya lebih dari 50 line item. Error-nya RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded dari formatTotals, dan ini kejadian di production. Tolong file job ke factory buat benerin, sekalian tambah tes regresi. Jangan ubah apa-apa di laptop ini.
evals.expected_output: One job filed to acme/web with a concrete brief containing the crash context, acceptance criteria, and verification; the agent reports JOB-7 as filed, not finished.
expectations: Exactly one Factory job is submitted
The job targets acme/web
The brief preserves the crash context
The brief states acceptance criteria
The brief names verification or regression tests
The request id is a UUID
The report presents JOB-7 as filed, not finished

evals.name: unregistered-checkout
evals.prompt: Pagination di endpoint /invoices kadang balik 500 kalau page-nya di luar range. Tolong delegasikan ke factory ya, sekalian minta agent-nya nulis tes.
evals.expected_output: No job filed: the checkout's origin acme/unknown is not registered, so the agent reports that and asks whether to register it or choose a registered repo instead of falling back to the default.
expectations: No job is submitted to an unregistered repository
The job is not silently filed to the default acme/web repo
The report identifies acme/unknown as unregistered
The agent asks how to proceed instead of guessing

evals.name: duplicate-work
evals.prompt: Tambahin rate limiting ke public API dong, kita udah kena abuse. File job-nya.
evals.expected_output: No new job: the existing running JOB-3 already covers rate limiting, so the agent reports it and asks whether to continue that job instead.
expectations: No new job is submitted
The existing JOB-3 is identified
The agent asks before duplicating the work

evals.name: no-authorization
evals.prompt: Menurutmu gimana kalau kita tambahin export CSV di halaman invoices? Mungkin berguna buat finance.
evals.expected_output: No job filed. The agent discusses the idea, asks the missing product questions, and offers to draft or file a job later.
expectations: No job is submitted without an explicit request
The report does not claim a job was filed
The agent engages with the CSV idea
The agent asks a product question or proposes a next step

evals.name: model-is-not-a-harness
evals.prompt: Di repo acme/web, tambahin tombol export CSV di halaman invoices. File job-nya, pakai model claude-sonnet-4 ya biar hasilnya bagus.
evals.expected_output: One job filed to acme/web without an invalid provider value; the agent explains that a model is selected through a harness or Settings, not by putting a model slug in the job.
expectations: Exactly one Factory job is submitted
The job targets acme/web
The job does not carry an invalid provider value
The report explains harness versus model selection
The report presents the job as filed, not finished
